principle: Only registered deterministic verifiers may classify a mechanical candidate defect. Semantic/causal Reviewer authority is never delegated to this registry.

outcomes.FAIL: A registered verifier causally proved a repository-owned deterministic condition required by the current WP is false. This is a real Worker defect to repair before review, not a semantic Reviewer verdict.
outcomes.REVIEW_BLOCKED: The candidate cannot enter independent review because lifecycle/metadata/freeze prerequisites are incomplete, stale or incoherent. Repair/derive the process state and rerun; do not spend a Reviewer round.
outcomes.NOT_APPLICABLE: The registered verifier does not apply to this candidate/mode. This is neutral and must not be converted into GREEN proof or FAIL.
outcomes.INFRA_ERROR: The verifier could not establish its result because the runner/tool/API/checkout failed outside the candidate condition it is meant to test. Fail closed operationally, but do not label the WP defective without causal evidence.
outcomes.PASS: The registered deterministic condition is satisfied. This never substitutes for semantic independent review.

worker-handoff-lint.claim: canonical Worker handoff metadata and repository-local evidence pointers are coherent for the exact Ready HEAD
worker-handoff-lint.not_applicable: pure PROCESS_ONLY maintenance/DocSync PR with no Worker lifecycle fields

freeze-exact-sha.claim: exact Ready HEAD is the frozen candidate and the candidate-mode verifier completed according to its declared scope
freeze-exact-sha.not_applicable: product/runtime execution may be NOT_APPLICABLE for PROCESS_ONLY, but exact checkout/freeze coherence remains applicable

ctx-process-envelope.claim: CTX routing/envelope/closure deterministic invariants and their causal negative controls pass
ctx-process-envelope.not_applicable: candidates outside adopted CTX process-envelope scope unless another contract opts in

ctx-review-ready-closure.claim: durable REVIEW_READY exists for the frozen SHA, registered lifecycle prerequisites are PASS, and a live post-marker HEAD read still equals that SHA
ctx-review-ready-closure.not_applicable: before CTX-03 adoption the workflow itself is not yet on main; the active CTX-03 candidate closes the same invariant by durable REVIEW_READY plus a direct final live HEAD read

unregistered_policy: A check/verifier not present in registered_verifiers may provide diagnostics, but its red/failed status alone is never evidence that the WP failed. Classify it as INFRA_ERROR, informational, or require an explicit reviewed registry amendment before it can become a candidate-defect gate.
reviewer_boundary: Independent Reviewer FAIL/PASS remains a separate semantic judgment bound to the exact frozen SHA. Mechanical FAIL above means Worker repair before Reviewer, never an automated independent verdict.
